ranked.headline: Graph and generative models for molecular property prediction and design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers couple graph and generative molecular models with property, synthesis, and activity constraints.

ranked.headline: Latent models separate confounding sources from single-cell and spatial measurements
ranked.summary: Interpretable generative models now partition latent sources such as cell cycle, perturbation, and aging in scRNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: Quantifying methodological limits and consensus strategies in microbial profiling software
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks quantify the limits of microbial profiling, from 16S database curation to whole-metagenome functional recovery.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient segmentation and alignment for microscopy and pathology images
ranked.summary: Label-efficient strategies now extend histology, electron, multiplexed and 3D tumour imaging segmentation in recent preprints and one published method.

ranked.headline: Explainable neural models predict regulatory activity and variant effects from DNA
ranked.summary: Architectures now pair sequence, 3D chromatin and language-model inputs with explainability to make genomic predictions more mechanistically readable.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory activity from splicing, cfDNA, and chromatin occupancy data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and cfDNA readouts now resolve splicing and regulatory activity, while benchmarks expose off-target and annotation artifacts.

ranked.headline: Feedback and canalization set robustness in cell-state and gene regulatory models
ranked.summary: Models now link bifurcation proximity, canalization, and feedback to robustness across cell cycle, gene networks, and epithelia.

ranked.headline: Machine learning on omics, histology and single-cell data for biological classification
ranked.summary: Learned models now integrate histology, multiomics and single-cell data for classification and trajectory analysis.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell tools infer tissue domains and pathway activity
ranked.summary: New spatial and single-cell resources, including a 9,316-dataset healthy-tissue portal, appeared in November 2025.

ranked.headline: MD simulations link distal allostery to conformational dynamics in nucleic acid systems
ranked.summary: Simulation studies from November 2025 use MD and coarse-grained models to map allosteric routes linking local flexibility to distal functional sites.

ranked.headline: Tree ensembles and packaged tools extend biomedical prediction across omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and journal releases add phylogeny-informed, ensemble, and Python-based tools for microbiome, histone, and cancer modeling.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed and generative models advance biomolecular structure, docking and design
ranked.summary: Diffusion, coarse-grained and physics-informed approaches now target docking, antibody CDR design and DNA simulation at larger scales.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks assess folding energy and ensemble models for protein variant interpretation
ranked.summary: Mega-scale folding data and ensemble benchmarks now test whether computed stability and structure scores support variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Machine learning maps sequence and chemistry to antibacterial activity and resistance
ranked.summary: Learned models are now linked to experimental validation, with a DeepQSAR study testing 100 designed peptides for antimicrobial and antibiofilm activity.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases map cell-type diversity in heart, fibroblasts, and developing cortex
ranked.summary: Integrated single-cell references now span 2.4 million heart nuclei and 60 human organs, enabling cross-tissue comparison of cell states.

ranked.headline: Deep learning predicts MS/MS spectra for PTMs, small molecules and DIA libraries
ranked.summary: Expanded training data and general-purpose language models now extend spectrum prediction to PTMs, small molecules, and experiment-specific DIA libraries.

ranked.headline: Language models infer biomedical properties from non-text inputs such as MRI and omics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply zero-shot and multimodal LLMs to imaging, omics, mass spectra, and metabolite data for biomedical prediction.

ranked.headline: Inferring biological dynamics and interaction parameters from data-driven models
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs mechanistic and data-driven modeling to recover biological dynamics and parameters from noisy or compositional observations.

ranked.headline: LLM agents now automate reanalysis, annotation and querying of transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: CellWhisperer embeds 1M transcriptomes with text, enabling chat-based querying as LLM agents enter transcriptomic analysis workflows.

ranked.headline: Graph and language-model fusion for protein function, drug-target and kinase prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method combine graph neural networks, LLM embeddings, and knowledge graphs to predict binding and kinase relationships.

ranked.headline: Learned models replace hand-engineered steps across sequencing and imaging tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply deep and attention-based models directly to raw microscopy, sequencing, and genomic data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and comparing inferred dependency networks for omics data
ranked.summary: Inferred dependency structure needs validation before omics integration, and simulated benchmarks and network comparison tests now address this.

ranked.headline: Resource supply, dosing, and noise as controllable variables in population models
ranked.summary: Simulation studies now treat resource structure, dosing schedules, and stochastic noise as tunable parameters governing persistence and treatment outcomes.

ranked.headline: Turning predicted biomolecular structures into physically grounded simulation inputs
ranked.summary: Structure-prediction outputs are being converted directly into MD-ready systems, alongside memory-bounded online trajectory clustering.

ranked.headline: Interactive tools integrate structure, genomic-neighbourhood, and pan-genome analyses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications deliver specialized sequence, structure, and omics analyses through user-facing web and R interfaces.

ranked.headline: Local rules set collective behavior in condensates, tissues, and neurons
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now link local crosslinking, feedback, and connectivity rules to measurable emergent material and network dynamics.

ranked.headline: Task-specific pipelines filter metabarcoding artifacts and delimit eDNA species units
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published pipeline address artifact removal and reference-free species delimitation in metabarcoding, alongside new eukaryotic genome and gene…

ranked.headline: Long-read data resolve haplotype-level and repetitive variation in human genomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend long-read analysis to mitochondrial phasing, methylation-guided haplotype correction, and telomere content across populations.

ranked.headline: Anisotropic models link intraocular pressure and tissue strain in lamina cribrosa
ranked.summary: Patient-specific and compartmental models now quantify how tissue stiffness and motility defects drive mechanical and transit outcomes.

ranked.headline: Cortical state and circuit dynamics shape neuronal tuning and response variability
ranked.summary: Analytic balanced-network theory and a parallel-pathway CNN now enable exact-likelihood circuit inference and state-separated variability analysis.

ranked.headline: ODE models link pre-clinical data to pharmacokinetic and survival predictions
ranked.summary: Integrated pre-clinical data and hybrid ODE models are now applied to cross-species pharmacokinetic translation and mixture toxicity prediction.

ranked.headline: Tools automate microbial probe design, signature discovery and genome annotation
ranked.summary: Recent releases automate probe design, signature discovery and bacterial genome annotation from large, heterogeneous sequence datasets.

ranked.headline: Age-related trajectories mapped from clinical tests, ovaries, and single-cell data
ranked.summary: Large-scale clinical and single-cell datasets now resolve aging trajectories at fine temporal and spatial resolution.

ranked.headline: Consistent species-tree methods and genome-scale phylogenetic confidence assessment
ranked.summary: Consistent coalescent-aware methods and scalable confidence assessment now reach network and two-million-genome phylogenies.

ranked.headline: Long-read tools for allele calling, read processing, and base-modification analysis
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now yields haplotype, read-level, and base-modification data that demand purpose-built, validated analysis software.

ranked.headline: Open tools turn lipidomics, GNPS, and MRS measurements into interpretable outputs
ranked.summary: Open, analysis-ready software now spans lipidomics, untargeted MS/MS, and MRS workflows from raw measurement to interpretation.
